Which of the following procedures would an auditor most likely perform before the balance sheet? date?
Option A: Confirm with client's lawyer that all litigation probable of assertion has been disclosed to the auditor.
Option B: Obtain an understanding of the client's internal control activities.
Option C: Determine whether there are any liens or encumbrances on assets that have been pledged as collateral.
Option D: Consider the client's plans and ability to meet imminent purchase commitments and cash flow obligations.
